name: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark
intro: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark 公开 400 个固定约束故事简报，覆盖十类元素且每题含 9–10 个实际约束。模型生成 600–800 个英文词的故事，只有完成作品进入同题、双顺序、多评判模型的稀疏成对比较；当前榜单在桥接验证后合并兼容的 evaluator-v2/v3 证据，并发布相对比较分、相对模型池的估计胜率与不确定区间。
build_method: 经 LLM 提议与评分筛选的固定约束简报, 版本化多评判模型成对比较
metric: Relative comparison score, estimated win chance, uncertainty range
task_type: 创意故事生成, 成对偏好评测
eval_feature: 双顺序评判, evaluator-v2/v3 桥接验证, 位置偏差校正, 分层 bootstrap
scale: 400 个固定创意简报；十类元素，每题 9–10 个实际约束
build_method_en: LLM-proposed and LLM-rated fixed constrained briefs, versioned multi-evaluator pairwise judging
eval_feature_en: Dual-order judging, evaluator-v2/v3 bridge validation, position-bias correction, hierarchical bootstrap
intro_en: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark publishes 400 fixed constrained story briefs spanning ten categories with 9–10 active constraints per prompt. Models generate 600–800-word English stories, and only completed outputs enter a sparse same-prompt, dual-order, multi-evaluator comparison graph. The current leaderboard combines compatible evaluator-v2/v3 evidence after bridge validation and reports a relative comparison score, estimated win chance against the model pool, and an uncertainty range.
scale_en: 400 fixed briefs; ten categories and 9–10 active constraints per prompt
metric_en: Relative comparison score, estimated win chance, uncertainty range

drawio_review_note: No associated paper, tagged release, or benchmark PDF was found. The current public bundle is pinned to official repository snapshot aaa0c11a8b4416fecbd6d215820d0792d4f03dbd; historical official snapshot 6ac3820205c8b0a45b74634be5e4ebf97c84ce8a documents LLM proposal/rating of element sets and parser/aggregation contracts, while 0286ecfcac37fbb3e19be4465662264de1e3ea98 documents dual-order averaging, side-position correction, and 95% bootstrap CIs. Audit of the pinned prompt bundle found 400 unique prompts across ten categories: 363 have ten active constraints and 37 contain one None value, leaving nine active constraints. The current leaderboard compares completed 600–800-word English stories on a sparse same-prompt graph, combines compatible evaluator-v2/v3 evidence only after shared-prompt and bridge-match validation, and reports comparison score, estimated win chance, and an uncertainty range. Historical documents specify winner/margin/signed-margin parsing, Thurstone-style least squares, diagnostic Bradley-Terry ratings, and hierarchical story-plus-evaluator bootstrap, but the current v2/v3 judge prompts, evaluator roster, bridge thresholds, parser/aggregation code, raw judgments, and exact formula implementation are not public. Archived absolute 0–10 rubric ratings are excluded from the current path.
